Animal Crime Bureau · https://animalcrimebureau.org/

Laws that protect animals are on the books. How far they are applied is rarely measured.

Egyptian law, by animal

Each category of animal falls under a different law, which punishes a different act with a different penalty. Bars show the highest amount in pounds that each penalty names, on one scale.
